candidate.answerReason: The radicand is 25/144, whose nonnegative square root is 5/12.

methods.label: Add before taking the square root
methods.explanation:
First combine the fractions inside the square root using the common denominator \(144\):
\[
\frac19+\frac1{16}
=\frac{16}{144}+\frac9{144}
=\frac{25}{144}.
\]
Since \(\left(\frac5{12}\right)^2=\frac{25}{144}\) and \(\frac5{12}>0\), the principal square root is
\[
\sqrt{\frac19+\frac1{16}}=\boxed{\frac5{12}},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
